title: 10 ANS PLUS TARD… 🍓

scenes.image: In a high school courtyard, a small shy girl with a strawberry head and a school backpack is mocked by a tall arrogant boy with a lemon head and his laughing friends with fruit heads.

lines.say: T'es trop petite, la Fraise ! Tu feras jamais rien de ta vie !

scenes.image: Ten years later, the strawberry-head woman, confident, in an elegant business suit, sits as CEO behind a big desk in a luxury glass office with a city skyline; the lemon-head man enters nervously for a job interview holding his CV.

lines.say: Dix ans plus tard, le Citron passe un entretien d'embauche.

scenes.image: Close-up: the lemon-head man recognizes the strawberry-head CEO and freezes, sweating, shocked; she smiles calmly, holding his CV.

lines.say: Alors… je suis toujours trop petite ?

caption:
🍓 Il se moquait d'elle au lycée… 10 ans plus tard, c'est ELLE la patronne 😳

Tu l'embauches ou pas ? 👇
Partie 2 ?
